race.comment: MAINSTAY (3) made the right statement on debut at Scone, winning a Maiden over 900m by just under two lengths after starting as a dominant odds-on favourite. He had trialled well beforehand, including a big Scone trial win, and although this is a quick return to CL1 grade, the manner of that first-up win says he has the scope to handle it. CASSIERE (2) usually races well second-up so can improve on her eighth when resuming at Scone. Include. REAL MCCOY (7) won his maiden last start at Coffs Harbour Maiden over 1014m for the new stable. Can go on with it. KERMITISAPET (10) has been freshened after a plain Scone run. In the mix fresh.
